_meta.status: Dispatch Engine v1. Seeded estimates, not NEMSIS data.
_meta.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: every frequency weight below is a seeded estimate. Replace with NEMSIS Public-Release Research Dataset weights when access arrives. Never present these as NEMSIS data.
_meta.samplerRule: The sampler draws one complaint weighted by weight within minLevel <= level. L1 stays to the simpler four; L2 may draw all eight.

complaints.label: Fall
complaints.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: seeded estimate. Ground-level falls in the elderly dominate real 911 volume; this weight keeps them common without drowning the mix.

complaints.label: Motor vehicle crash
complaints.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: seeded estimate. Covers car, motorcycle, pedestrian-struck and bicycle subtypes via complaintMechanisms.

complaints.label: Chest pain
complaints.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: seeded estimate. V1 physiology is the stress-response placeholder only; coronary pathophysiology is Nov 2 scope.

complaints.label: Assault
complaints.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: seeded estimate. Blunt assault and sports-impact subtypes; penetrating assault is under stabbing and gunshot.

complaints.label: Overdose
complaints.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: seeded estimate. V1 toxidrome is narrative-only (history card, persona, scene clues); engine pathophysiology is Nov 2 scope.

complaints.label: Allergic reaction
complaints.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: seeded estimate. V1 physiology is the stress-response placeholder only; anaphylactic-shock pathophysiology is Nov 2 scope.

complaints.label: Stabbing
complaints.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: seeded estimate. V1 models the leg-stab subset (femoral bleed); torso-stab pathophysiology is narrative-only until Nov 2.

complaints.label: Gunshot
complaints.sourceNote: WEIGHT_EST: seeded estimate. V1 models the extremity subset (femoral bleed); torso and head pathophysiology is narrative-only until Nov 2.
